readmeMarkdown:
# Antigravity Chat Importer

> Seamlessly import local **Claude Code** and **Codex** conversations into **Google Antigravity** — with 4-tier smart project matching, automatic deduplication, full Markdown archives, and ready-to-resume handoff context.

[中文文档](./README.zh-CN.md) · MIT License · Python 3.10+ (zero third-party dependencies)

---

## Why This Exists

Switching between **Claude Code / Claude Desktop (Code tab)**, **Codex CLI / Desktop**, and **Google Antigravity** usually means leaving long debugging sessions and architectural context behind.

**Antigravity Chat Importer** is an Antigravity Plugin + Skill (`/import-chats`) that:

- Reads your local Claude & Codex JSONL transcripts **read-only** (never modifies source logs).
- Filters out automated noise (Claude security-review hooks, Codex Guardian reviews, internal subagent rollouts).
- Matches each conversation's original working directory to your **Antigravity Projects** using a **4-tier smart matcher**.
- Exports clean, readable Markdown transcripts (`transcript.md`) and high-signal continuation briefings (`handoff.md`) — including prior compaction summaries and modified file lists.
- Uses Antigravity's official `ConversationService` API (`CreateConversation`) to spin up ready-to-resume Antigravity conversations in chronological order so your latest work sits right at the top of the sidebar.

---

## Features

- **Dual-source unified parser**: Supports both Claude (`~/.claude/projects/` + Claude Desktop `claude-code-sessions/`) and Codex (`~/.codex/sessions/` + `session_index.jsonl`, plus optional `--include-archived`).
- **4-tier smart project matching**:
  1. **Exact path match** (supports both plain local folders and Git repository projects in Antigravity).
  2. **Git worktree & remote URL resolution** (automatically maps `.claude/worktrees/...`, linked `.git` worktrees, and matching `origin` remotes back to the main project).
  3. **Deepest ancestor directory match** (e.g., `~/Documents/Codex/2026-11-26/task-a` automatically binds to an Antigravity project rooted at `~/Documents/Codex`).
  4. **Moved-folder fallback & custom aliases** (matches moved directories by unique project basename or via `~/.antigravity-chat-importer/aliases.json`).
- **Missing-project preflight**: Always previews which local folders are not yet added to Antigravity Projects before creating conversations (since a conversation's `projectId` is immutable once created).
- **Idempotent deduplication**: Tracks imported `source:session_id` pairs in `~/.antigravity-chat-importer/state.json` so re-running never creates duplicate conversations.
- **Three import modes**:
  - `handoff` *(default)*: Injects a concise continuation briefing (using `flash_lite` by default to save quota) so every imported thread is immediately resumable.
  - `empty`: Creates titled conversations under the right projects with zero model token usage + local Markdown archives.
  - `archive-only`: Exports Markdown transcripts and handoff docs offline (works in any terminal, even outside Antigravity).

---

## Quick Start

### Option 1: One-command install (recommended)

```bash
git clone https://github.com/kuangre123/antigravity-chat-importer.git \
  ~/.gemini/config/plugins/antigravity-chat-importer
```

### Option 2: Clone anywhere and symlink with `install.sh`

```bash
git clone https://github.com/kuangre123/antigravity-chat-importer.git
cd antigravity-chat-importer
./install.sh
```

Antigravity automatically discovers plugins in `~/.gemini/config/plugins/`. No restart required — `/import-chats` is available on your very next turn.

---

## Usage Inside Antigravity

In any Antigravity conversation, invoke `/import-chats` or ask in plain language:

```text
/import-chats scan all --limit 20
/import-chats codex 15
/import-chats claude 30
/import-chats codex://threads/01a21ad3-730a-7493-83af-064189d159c1
/import-chats all --project my-app
/import-chats all --since 7d
```

### Scheduled Incremental Sync (Optional)

If you continue using Claude Code or Codex alongside Antigravity, you can use Antigravity's built-in `/schedule` command to sync newly active chats daily:

```text
/schedule every day at 23:00 run /import-chats all --since 24h --only-matched
```

### Offline Markdown Export (Any Terminal)

Outside Antigravity, you can still scan histories or export clean Markdown archives without calling Antigravity's local API:

```bash
python3 skills/import-chats/scripts/import_chats.py scan --source all --limit 30
python3 skills/import-chats/scripts/import_chats.py import --source all --limit 30 --mode archive-only
```

---

## Custom Path Aliases (Optional)

If you moved or renamed old project directories, create `~/.antigravity-chat-importer/aliases.json`:

```json
{
  "/Users/you/old-folder/my-app": "/Users/you/projects/my-app",
  "/Users/you/Documents/legacy-notes": "notes-project"
}
```

Values can be either a new filesystem path (prefix-matched) or an existing Antigravity project name.

---

## CLI Reference

```text
python3 skills/import-chats/scripts/import_chats.py <scan|import|status> [options]
```

| Flag | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `--source {claude,codex,all}` | `all` | Which tool histories to read |
| `--limit N` | `20` | Max most recent sessions (`0` = unlimited) |
| `--project QUERY` | — | Filter by project name or path substring |
| `--id ID` | — | Target a specific UUID, prefix, or `codex://threads/<uuid>` |
| `--since WINDOW` | — | Filter by recency (`24h`, `7d`, `2w`, `2026-11-01`) |
| `--include-archived` | `false` | Also scan `~/.codex/archived_sessions` |
| `--only-matched` | `false` | Only include sessions matching an existing Antigravity project |
| `--mode {handoff,empty,archive-only}` | `handoff` | Import strategy (`import` subcommand) |
| `--model ALIAS` | `flash_lite` | Model alias/ID for handoff ingestion (`flash_lite`, `flash`, `pro`) |
| `--batch-size N` | `3` | Conversations created per batch before waiting for `RUN_STATE_IDLE` |
| `--no-prefix-unmatched` | `false` | Don't prepend `[projectName]` when falling back to default area |
| `--no-dedup` | `false` | Re-import even if already recorded in `state.json` |

### Environment Variables

| Variable | Default | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `AGY_IMPORTER_DATA_DIR` | `~/.antigravity-chat-importer` | Where `state.json`, `aliases.json`, `INDEX.md`, and `archives/` are stored |
| `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` | `~/.claude` | Override Claude Code config directory |
| `CODEX_HOME` | `~/.codex` | Override Codex home directory |
| `AGY_PROJECTS_DIR` | `~/.gemini/config/projects` | Override Antigravity projects directory (read-only) |

---

## Safety & Limitations

- **Strictly read-only on source histories and project configs**: Never modifies `~/.claude/`, `~/.codex/`, or `~/.gemini/config/projects/`.
- **Why doesn't it auto-create Antigravity Projects?** Antigravity currently exposes a documented `ConversationService` API for conversations, not a public project-creation API (project files also hold directory permission boundaries). Instead, `scan` tells you the exact missing folders so you can add them in seconds via the sidebar **`+`** button — once added, future imports bind automatically forever.
- **Local only**: Everything runs locally on your machine; no data is sent to any third-party service.

---

## Development & Tests

```bash
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
```

## Highlights / 亮点

- **Dual-source unified importer (Claude + Codex)**: Scans local Claude Code / Claude Desktop (Code tab) and Codex CLI / Desktop JSONL logs read-only.
- **Automatic noise filtering**: Skips Claude security-review hook sessions, Codex Guardian reviews, and internal subagent rollouts.
- **4-tier smart project matching**: Exact path, Git worktree / remote URL, deepest ancestor directory, and moved-folder basename + custom aliases.
- **Idempotent deduplication & Markdown archives**: Tracks imported IDs in `~/.antigravity-chat-importer/state.json` and writes readable `transcript.md`, `handoff.md`, and `INDEX.md`.
- **Zero third-party dependencies**: Pure Python 3.10+ stdlib; ships as a native Antigravity Plugin (`/import-chats`).

## Quick Install / 快速安装

```bash
git clone https://github.com/kuangre123/antigravity-chat-importer.git \
  ~/.gemini/config/plugins/antigravity-chat-importer
```
